items.raw_excerpt: There are – relatively speaking – few American citizens who settle in Switzerland for good, but those who do, tend to live predominantly in four cantons.
items.summary_en: Relatively few American citizens settle in Switzerland for good. But those who do tend to live in just four cantons. Their choices are surprisingly concentrated.

items.title_en: Which parts of Switzerland do American citizens choose to live in?

items.raw_excerpt: The practice of so-called prison outsourcing has been used by other countries, including Sweden, to alleviate overcrowding.
items.summary_en: Finland is thinking about sending some convicts to other countries. Its prisons are getting too full. Sweden has used this idea before.

items.title_original: Finland considers sending convicts abroad as domestic prisons become overcrowded

items.raw_excerpt: Around 60 Wolt couriers staged a temporary walkout in Reykjavík, saying earnings have fallen sharply as Icelandic labour organisations backed their protest.
items.summary_en: Around 60 Wolt delivery couriers held a short walkout in Reykjavik. They said their earnings have fallen sharply. Icelandic labour groups supported their protest.

items.summary_en: Warsaw has started patrols to deal with electric scooters that are parked in the wrong places. The city wants sidewalks and public spaces to stay clear and safe for everyone.

items.raw_excerpt: Bangkok commuters are set to benefit from a common fare of no more than 45 baht per trip on all electric train lines from Jan 1, 2027, under a government measure aimed at easing the cost of living.
items.summary_en: Starting January 1, 2027, riders in Bangkok will pay no more than 45 baht per trip on all electric train lines. The government set the cap to help people deal with the cost of living.
items.summary_ko: 2027년 1월 1일부터 방콕의 모든 전동열차 노선에서 한 번 탈 때 최대 45바트만 내면 됩니다. 정부는 생활비 부담을 덜기 위해 상한 요금을 도입했습니다.
items.title_en: Bangkok train fares capped at 45 baht from January
items.title_ko: 방콕 전동열차 요금, 1월 1일부터 45바트 상한 적용
items.title_original: Bangkok rail fares to be capped at B45 from Jan 1

items.raw_excerpt: Rodrigo de la Calle, gerente de la Asociación Chilena de Seguridad, explicó que manejar después de un día sin dormir equivale a "hacerlo con 0,1 gramos de alcohol en la sangre". "La principal causa de los accidentes fatales se debe a una conducta imprudente de los conductores, (siendo) el exceso de velocidad la peor dentro de todas", advirtió.
items.summary_en: Chile's safety association says driving after a sleepless night is like driving with alcohol in the blood. They warn that speeding is the worst cause of fatal crashes.
items.summary_ko: 칠레 안전협회는 하루를 잠 못 자고 운전하는 것이 혈중 알코올 0.1그램 상태와 같다고 밝혔다. 사망 사고의 주원인은 운전자의 위험 행동이며, 그중 과속이 가장 심각하다고 경고했다.
items.title_en: Chile Safety Group: Driving Tired Is Like Driving Drunk
items.title_ko: 칠레 안전협회 "잠 부족 운전은 음주 운전과 같다"
items.title_original: AChS: Conducir sin suficiente descanso equivale a hacerlo después de beber alcohol

items.raw_excerpt: A new report shows that Copenhagen is one of the most expensive cities in Europe to take public transport, ranking 27 out of 30.
items.summary_en: A new report ranks Copenhagen 27th out of 30 European cities for public transport costs. The report says taking buses, trains, and metro in the city is very pricey. Commuters in Copenhagen pay some of the highest fares in Europe.
items.summary_ko: 새 보고서에 따르면 코펜하겐은 유럽 30개 도시 가운데 대중교통 요금이 두 번째로 비싼 지역으로 27번째 순위에 올랐습니다. 이 도시에서 버스, 기차, 지하철을 타는 것은 매우 비쌉니다. 코펜하겐에서 출퇴근하는 주민들이 유럽에서 가장 높은 교통비를 내고 있는 것입니다.
items.title_en: Copenhagen public transport is one of the most expensive in Europe

items.title_original: Copenhagen's public transport among Europe's most expensive

items.raw_excerpt: Gathering around a campfire to cook sausages (pølser) or brew coffee is a key part of Norwegian outdoor culture, and now that the summer campfire ban is over, you can once again light fires in forests and open areas.
items.summary_en: Cooking sausages or brewing coffee over a campfire is a key part of outdoor life in Norway. The summer campfire ban has ended, so people can light fires again in forests and open areas.
items.summary_ko: 소시지를 굽거나 커피를 끓이는 것은 노르웨이 야외 문화의 중요한 부분입니다. 여름 모닥불 금지가 끝나 이제 숲과 공터에서 다시 불을 피울 수 있습니다.
items.title_en: What are Norway's rules for having a campfire in autumn?
items.title_ko: 가을 노르웨이 모닥불 규칙은?
items.title_original: What are Norway's rules for having a campfire in autumn?

items.raw_excerpt: Iceland’s coastal fishing fleet is taking a first step toward electrification as Grænafl prepares to convert Oddverji SI 76 from diesel to electric power.
items.summary_en: A small Icelandic fishing boat, Oddverji SI 76, will be changed from diesel to electric power. The firm Grenfl will do the change. This is the first step toward electric boats for Iceland's coastal fishing fleet.

items.raw_excerpt: Thai-born global pop star Lalisa “Lisa” Manobal introduced US talk-show host Jimmy Fallon to som tam and her “special” cocktail made with Korean soju, Thai Chang beer and Sprite as she promoted her forthcoming mini-album on his popular late-night show.
items.summary_en: Thai star Lisa introduced talk-show host Jimmy Fallon to som tam. She also showed him her special cocktail made with soju, Chang beer, and Sprite while promoting her new mini-album.

items.summary_en: A regional energy official in Coquimbo, Chile, resigned from his post. The move followed concerns about his academic credentials. The resignation was confirmed on Wednesday night.

items.raw_excerpt: María José Catala: «Todas las ciudades están pagando las consecuencias de la fallida política migratoria»
items.summary_en: The mayor of Valencia said the city will give its Medal of Honor to the people of Ceuta. She said Spain's failed migration policy hurts everyone and all cities pay the price. Ceuta is a small Spanish city on the coast of Africa.

items.raw_excerpt: The Azores Seismic and Volcanic Information and Surveillance Centre (CIVISA) has lowered the volcanic alert level for the Furnas volcano on São Miguel Island to V0 (volcanic system in a resting phase), according to an agency source.

items.summary_en: Carolina Holguín, former president of Eldense, said the sale of the club to Lionel Messi is final. She said the club is now in the best hands. Eldense is a small team in Spain's Second Division.

items.raw_excerpt: The Minister of Environment and Energy, Maria da Graça Carvalho, refused on 16 September to end the bottle-and-can return system in Portugal.
items.summary_en: Portugal's Environment and Energy Minister Maria da Graça Carvalho refused on 16 September to end the bottle-and-can return system. The program, known as Volta, collects used bottles and cans across the country.

items.raw_excerpt: A Thai luxury property developer and a socialite fashion designer are feuding in court over a luxury “lifestyle experience” cruise that the developer says did not live up to its expectations for marketing exposure.
items.summary_en: A Thai luxury property developer and a socialite fashion designer are now feuding in court. The fight is over a luxury cruise that was meant to boost marketing. The developer says the cruise failed to meet its expectations.

items.raw_excerpt: RTÉ has confirmed that Ireland will not take part in the 2027 Eurovision Song Contest and that it will not broadcast the competition.

items.raw_excerpt: In Skowhegan, we did not want to just build a school; we wanted to build a case for a new way forward.
items.summary_en: In Skowhegan, Maine, people built a public school that serves the whole town. The school also cares for babies and toddlers. It shows a new way for rural communities to come together.

items.raw_excerpt: Germany's 'Elternzeit' may sound like time off, but the first year with a baby can be lonely, chaotic and full of admin. From Familienzentren to Kleinanzeigen, journalist and new parent Imogen Goodman writes about how to get through it.
items.summary_en: Germany's Elternzeit may sound like time off, but the first year with a baby can be lonely, chaotic and full of admin. Journalist and new parent Imogen Goodman writes about how to get through it, from Familienzentren to Kleinanzeigen.
items.summary_ko: 독일의 육아휴직은 휴식처럼 들리지만, 아이와 보내는 첫 1년은 고독하고 정신없으며 서류 처리로 가득할 수 있다. 신혼·신규 부모인 기자 임전 굿먼이 패밀리젠트런에서 클라이네안차이겐까지, 그 시기를 어떻게 버텨낼지 이야기한다.

items.summary_en: Families in Graz with a new baby can choose one of six tree species for free. The city is offering the trees as part of its welcome scheme. Parents can collect their trees on special days at the end of September.
